about.title: About Kayan Misr Party..
about.subtitle: A national vision to empower talent and support the state
about.text: Kayan Shabab Misr is a youth political institution founded in 2018, inspired by the National Youth Conferences and the political leadership's call to develop Egyptian political life. It brings together academic and professional youth to offer a different public-service experience that unites young people, raises constitutional awareness, and genuinely prepares them for decision making.

points.title: Legislative and oversight training:

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about Kayan and membership
faq.subtitle: Everything you want to know about joining, activities, and opportunities.

items.q: Who are we, and what is Kayan Misr?
items.a: Kayan Misr is a national youth party founded in 2018 that spreads constitutional culture and prepares young cadres for public and parliamentary work.
To build an aware generation able to take an active part in political life and support state institutions in line with Egypt Vision 2030.

items.q: What are the official membership requirements?
items.a: Applicants must be Egyptian citizens in full possession of their civil rights and committed to Kayan's principles and bylaws.

items.q: How do registration and selection work?
items.a: Apply through the online membership form; the membership committee then contacts you for an introductory interview.

items.q: What volunteer and research opportunities are available?
items.a: Members can join specialized committees, research teams, event organization, and simulation and training programs.

intro.title: Youth voices at the National Dialogue table
intro.text: Kayan Misr takes part in National Dialogue sessions with trained youth delegations that carry young people's views and proposals to every track, and follows up on implementing the recommendations with the relevant bodies.
points: Submitting youth proposals through well-researched working papers.
Holding preliminary listening sessions in the governorates before each round.
Tracking dialogue outcomes and measuring their real-world impact.

dialogue.axesSubtitle: We take part in all three tracks of the National Dialogue through specialized member committees.

axes.title: Political track
axes.text: Political rights, the electoral system, local government, human rights, and public freedoms.

axes.title: Economic track
axes.text: Inflation and prices, private investment, industry and agriculture, and public debt.

axes.title: Social track
axes.text: Education and health, culture and national identity, family and social cohesion, and youth.
